name: What steps are involved in planning a custom basement design from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: What steps are involved in planning a custom basement design from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: A custom basement design starts with an on-site consultation to inspect your existing foundation, ceiling heights, and utility layout. Owner Abraham Becerra reviews your goals, takes measurements, and sketches space configurations for bedrooms, bathrooms, or home theaters. Once framing and layout plans are approved, HH Remodeling handles the custom framing, drywall, finish carpentry, and tile installation, while coordinating licensed trade partners for plumbing and electrical rough-ins. Clear sequencing keeps the project moving smoothly from raw concrete to final paint.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves an initial walk-through, layout planning, custom framing, mechanical rough-ins, drywall, tile, and final trim and paint work.
